incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Killed container observed on inference node gpu-w1-34 in cluster inference-west-1. Autoscaler reported OOM kill during prefill. Pager: @alex (oncall)

alex (oncall): seeing repeated container restarts on gpu-w1-34, bumping here. GPU memory usage spiked before kill.

devon (runtime): grabbing logs now. `kubelet` shows `Killed process 14231 (runtime) total-vm 1.4T -> oom`. Also CUDA errors: `CUDARuntimeError: out of memory` during prefill for a very large request.

morgan (infra): node metrics show sustained memory growth over ~3m. Node wasn't OOM previously. Investigating whether prefill backpressure is working.

alex (oncall): impact? any customer-facing errors? paula, can you check support queue for user errors in the last 15m?

paula (support): seeing ~7 user errors with `503` and `container restart` msgs, one high-traffic customer reported failed batch jobs. I'll flag for CS.

devon (runtime): pasting stack-ish snippet:
```
[2026-03-15 10:12:23] prefill_worker.cpp: alloc_kv_cache(positions=120000) -> attempted_bytes=38GB
[CUDARuntimeError] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
killed by OOM
```
Not exact, but indicates prefill attempted very large KV allocation (long context ~120k tokens -> KV huge).

morgan (infra): node has GPU 80GB, but contiguous allocation needed; with multiple pods it's tight. There was a huge single-request prefill.

alex (oncall): immediate mitigation options:
- block requests with context > 32k at gateway (fast)
- enable prefill rejection policy (runtime) for large contexts
- cordon/drain node and move workload
Which should we do now? thoughts?

devon (runtime): I can push a temporary runtime config to reject prefill > 32k and reduce per-request KV reserve to 60% of GPU mem. Patch ready and tested in staging.

morgan (infra): I'll cordon gpu-w1-34 and start draining pods to other nodes. Also will increase reserved capacity pool by +1 to absorb traffic during drain.

jen (ops-lead): please include exact CLI commands in thread for oncall handover.

morgan (infra): running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-w1-34
kubectl drain gpu-w1-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Scaling dedicated-pool: `kubectl scale deploy/dedicated-pool --replicas=6`

devon (runtime): deploying runtime config (canary to 10% first):
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{ "prefill_max_tokens": 32768, "kv_reserve_fraction": 0.6 }
```
Canary to 10% now.

incident-bot: Deployment canary started (10% of runtime pods). Rolling update logs: `canary ok`.

alex (oncall): patch accepted on canary, starting rollout. Keeping one eye on errors.

~3m later~

paula (support): customer-impact update: 7 requests failed, 1 paid customer reported retries caused downstream job delay (non-critical). Alerted CS to prepare comms.

morgan (infra): gpu-w1-34 drained successfully. No further OOM kills on other nodes after runtime canary.

alex (oncall): rolling config to 100% now.

devon (runtime): rollout done. Also added short-term reject rule in gateway config to fail fast for content-length > 5MB (heuristic for huge contexts). Gateway rule:
```
if request.context_tokens > 32768 -> 413 Request Entity Too Large
```

lucy (cs): noted. paula, I added the impacted customer's ticket and draft message. We'll mention transient 503s and that infra rolled mitigation; ETA for postmortem TBD.

jen (ops-lead): handing to morgan for follow-up escalation and to devon for postmortem action items. I'll mark this incident as RESOLVED for immediate P0 and create follow-up task for root cause analysis.

alex (oncall): handing off to morgan for next oncall window. Summary for next: GPU OOM during prefill caused killed containers on gpu-w1-34. Immediate mitigation: runtime prefill cap, gateway reject, node drain, scale-up. Impact: ~7 customer requests, 1 customer task delayed. No data loss. Postmortem owner: devon.

morgan (infra): ack. I'll monitor for 1h and coordinate with devon for reproducible test harness (large prefill sim).

devon (runtime): adding TODOs to postmortem:
- reproduce exact allocation pattern in loadtest
- implement long-term instrumentation for prefill KV growth
- add auto-reject and throttling with per-customer limits
- add graceful prefill failure path to avoid container kill

paula (support): CS notified affected customer, offered retries/credits. Will escalate if they request immediate SLA credit.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by alex at 2026-03-15T10:25:20Z. Follow-up tasks created: `INC-1851236789-rtm` (postmortem) and `INC-1851236789-gw` (gateway cap). :white_check_mark:

alex (oncall): closing thread here. Good response team.
